products.description: About the Author Singer, song-writer, author, and humorist Jeff Nathan is the creator of PunOETRY(TM). Author of "Calling All Animals" and "There's a Hippo in My Locker", Mr. Nathan's poetry and music brings laughter everywhere it goes. He is a member of the Society of Children's Book Writers and Illustrators and works and invests toward the improvement of children's literacy in the US. Excerpt. © Reprinted by permission. All rights reserved. (Please note that the spacing and boldfaced and italicized contributions of PunOETRY are restricted to normal type here, and spacing is not as published.) Crustaceans (Copyright 2003 by Chucklebooks Publishing, Inc.) Crustaceans are an interesting breed; Some people think theyre swell fish. But dont believe in everything you read  I find them rather shellfish. (selfish) ---------------------------------------- Duck! (Copyright 2003 by Chucklebooks Publishing, Inc.) Theyve been quacking so much about Mabels big flight  How she soared like a jet in the stadiums light, How she heard all the cheers as she tilted her wings And then twisted and curved out those spirally things. She would weave in and out as she spun all her spins, Neatly outing her outs and then inning her ins. She was painting the sky with her brush widely spread, Till that baseball flew into the side of her head. Quickly plummeting down, Mabels fate appeared sealed, And they all feared the worst as she lay in right field. But Im pleased to report that I did make it through, And despite all the talk I have this to tell you: Theyve been quacking and honking all day about me, But the day wasnt all it was quacked up to be. (cracked) ---------------------------------------- A Clothes-minded Vacuum (Closed-minded) (Copyright 2003 by Chucklebooks Publishing, Inc.) My mom has chores that she assigns. I do them perfectly. But I have found that vacuuming is not a chore for me. I used to do it all the time, until that fateful day The vacuum cleaner acted in a most unfriendly way. For, as I ran the vacuum, cleaning all the dust and dirt, The hose I held escaped me and it turned and got my shirt. The vacuum sucked the shirt down then it took my new watch, too. And, next, it seemed quite focused on the thought of my left shoe. Before I had the chance to run, my precious shoe was gone. And then the vacuum snuck up on the shoe I still had on. To save my things from leaving me, I had to jump and dance. But, soon, the hose  it tricked me and it pulled away my pants. Now stranded in my underwear, I started fighting back  I couldnt be left naked from this horrible attack. I wrestled firmly with the hose and got it to the ground. I clenched my teeth and grunted as I got it turned around. What happened next was definitely something very weird: The vacuum swallowed up itself and simply disappeared.

dialogue.user: Those are some interesting options. I'm particularly drawn to **"Hit The Road!: A Badass Mom's Guide For Families who Want to Travel the World"** and **"Musings & Vignettes: A sketchbook for thoughts and illustrations"**. Could you tell me more about these two books? What are they about?
dialogue.agent:
Here are more details about the books you're interested in:

- **"Hit The Road!: A Badass Mom's Guide For Families who Want to Travel the World"** - $12.99, Rating: 5.0, Reviews: 3, Rating Number: 6
  - Features: This book is a comprehensive guide for families dreaming of traveling with their children. It offers practical advice on logistics, schooling, remote working, meeting other travelers, handling travel emergencies, and more. Filled with inspiring stories and interviews from traveling families, it provides valuable insights and lessons learned. It's perfect for those who admire other families traveling the world and want to do the same.

- **"Musings & Vignettes: A sketchbook for thoughts and illustrations"** - $5.00, Rating: 5.0, Reviews: 3, Rating Number: 3
  - Features: This sketchbook is a beautiful way to capture your drawings, ideas, and thoughts. It includes 50 blank pages, offering a stylish and creative space to make plans and let your imagination run wild.

Would you like to know more about any specific book or proceed with a purchase?

result.title: Hit The Road!: A Badass Mom's Guide For Families who Want to Travel the World
result.features: You don’t have to decide whether to work OR travel...you can do both! Hit the Road! is a book to inspire families who have always dreamed of traveling with their children. Whether for a year or a lifetime, if you’re a single mother of one or a traditional family of five, this book explains how to take those first steps to get on the road, and what to do once you’re there. It looks at logistics and schooling, remote working, and how to meet others, travel emergencies, and much more.Filled with inspiration, practical information, and personal anecdotes – interviews with traveling families who share how they did it and their lessons learned – Hit the Road! will educate you about the fast-growing community of “Worldschooling” and traveling families. If you are someone who marvels at other families traveling the world and imagine doing the same, then this book is for you! So many families are already doing it... you can too.

result.title: Musings & Vignettes: A sketchbook for thoughts and illustrations
result.features: This sketchbook is a beautiful way to capture your drawings, ideas and thoughts. This stylish book includes 50 blank pages where you can make plans and let your imagination run wild.
